title.narrative: Enhanced Local Value Addition and Strengthening Value Chains

description.narrative: The UNIDO project to enhance local value addition and strengthen agor-value chains is a sub component of the intregrated programme l aunched by EU in the Greater Bahr El Ghazal region in South Sudan to contribute to the improvement of food security and income of the rural population. In consideration of the axial role and the important potential of small holders to boost the rural economy and r each a sustainable food security level in the country, this project will assist farmers, farmer organizations and existing and new production groups in the four states of Greater Bahr El Ghazal region, namely; the Northern Bahr El Ghaza (NbG), Western Bahr el GhazalWbG), Lakes and Warrap.
